package codestructuretype

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
)

// ListCodeStructureTypes lists code structure types with pagination.
type ListCodeStructureTypes struct {
	Structures repository.CodeStructureTypeRepository
}

// Handle returns type list.
func (uc ListCodeStructureTypes) Handle(ctx context.Context, filter filters.CodeStructureTypeFilters) ([]domain.CodeStructureType, int, error) {
	return uc.Structures.List(ctx, filter)
}
